What Makes Nandhi Bhavana the Pride of Chamarajanagar?

Whether for sacred Hindu weddings, grand receptions, naming ceremonies, or corporate conventions, Nandhi Bhavana brings a standard of excellence you can count on. Operated by the Nandhi Group (Symbol of Service) alongside Hotel Nandhi Inn, our convention centre combines a 700-seat pillar-free view auditorium, a massive ground-floor pure vegetarian banquet hall, and 16 guest rooms.
